visualCharacteristics: Vertical news list. Each teaser is one clickable card with the image on the left and, on the right, a meta line (date | category), the headline, a short text and a 'Weiterlesen' line.
contentPattern: One row per teaser (cells in any order) or all teasers flat in one cell. Content is classified, not indexed: picture = image, a dd.mm.yyyy paragraph = date, a link-free paragraph before the heading = category, h2–h6 = headline (starts a new teaser), a paragraph with only one link = card link / read-more text, anything else = teaser text.
usage: News list in the main column of the home page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for dated news or press teasers with image, headline and text. For grid card layouts without dates use cards.
